description: add semantic commit scope for this repo's own toolchain manifest.
package.json + bun.lock exist only to pin the commitlint that the commit-messages gate and
ci/scripts/commit-taxonomy/verify-commit-taxonomy.mjs both run. They reach no cluster and sit
in no release-please package, so their bumps maintain an internal surface rather than shipping
Both managers are matched because which one claims a package.json depends on whether a bun
lockfile sits beside it. The shared dev-tools preset at the pinned ref lists only npm and
poetry, so without this rule a bun-claimed bump would fall through to the per-update-type
defaults and emit feat:/fix: with an empty scope -- a shipped claim for a dev dependency.
semanticCommitType is pinned here for the same reason: the type must not vary with the update
type on a surface that never ships.
